author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] #352 voice-reconnect-on-bridge-error covers one narrow case of healing a call: on vibe-talk-v1, an error frame that asks the client to reconnect, during a call whose session started, carries the call on a new session (at most once a rolling minute and three times a call), handing it the call's record where the session takes one and Resuming is on. Drops, closes (see #357), the hosted protocol, and a redial after a hang-up are not covered and remain this issue's.
